subject: Charged a late fee for paying on the due date
description: Hi, invoice INV-2041 was due on March 15. I paid it on March 15 in the afternoon, but the bill shows a $25.00 late fee and a total of $505.00 instead of $480.00. Your terms say I can pay any time on the due date. Please remove the fee and fix this so it doesn't happen again.
agent_notes: Confirmed in the billing repo: `npm run invoice -- INV-2041` shows late fee $25.00. paidAt is 2026-03-15T16:42:00Z and dueDate is 2026-03-15. Rule 2 in docs/billing-rules.md says that payment is on time.
